title: Sonic Was Almost A Rabbit 🐰 #shorts
description:
Sonic was almost a rabbit. 🐰
In 1990, Sega artist Naoto Ohshima drew rival mascots: a rabbit that grabbed things with its ears, a dog, an armadillo and a mustached man in pajamas. Strangers in New York's Central Park picked the hedgehog... and the mustached man became Dr. Eggman.
Sources: Vice, Den of Geek, Sonic Retro
